fields.description: R. Hills is a gated townhouse community in Dubailand. Three-, four- and five-bedroom homes use three levels to separate ground-floor living spaces from bedrooms, with outdoor areas that vary between the named types.

overview: The factsheet records 902 townhouses: 744 three-bedroom, 66 four-bedroom and 92 five-bedroom homes.
research.priceNote: Property Finder labels AED 2.6m as a launch price; Time Homes advertises AED 2.59m. No current developer unit quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: Reference: Time Homes lists 20% booking, 10% within 12 months and 70% handover. Property Finder’s displayed 20/10/30 totals only 60%; it is not a complete payment schedule.
research.handoverNote: Developer page and factsheet target Q4 2028; Property Finder corroborates December 2028. This is a forecast. The webpage’s undated “Starting Soon” construction label does not establish current progress.
unresolved: Areas include balconies, backyard and front yard, not just enclosed interiors. All figures cover complete three-level homes.
Printed component totals differ slightly for some types; the published total sellable figures are retained.
Current stock, fees, charges, plot boundaries and binding delivery terms require confirmation.
